description: Source code for ProjectsController class managing project-related API endpoints in a team collaboration platform backend.

classes.name: ProjectsController
classes.description: Controller class providing API methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and managing project members.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists projects the current user owns or is a member of.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project owned by the current user and adds them as an admin member.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project if the user has access.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates project details; only accessible by the owner.

methods.name: addMember
methods.description: Adds a member to a project; owner only in current implementation.
